spanish: Querubín uno desde el extremo desde este, y querubín uno desde el extremo desde este; desde la kappóret hizo a los querubines desde sus dos extremos.

findings.issue: Definite common feminine singular noun is left as the untranslated form kappóret.
Token is only the preposition plus dual construct cardinal two; Spanish adds a possessive and the noun extremos.
Spanish puts a definite article on extremo; morphology is preposition plus absolute singular noun with no article.

notes: The repeated cherub-one clauses, the conjunction, the verb, the object marker, and the plural cherubim match their tokens.
